profile: SQLite 3.47.2 with its builtin routine registry and MAX_FUNCTION_ARG=127.

Expression/Nulls/Coalesce.role: The ordered first non-NULL operation of SQLite COALESCE and binary IFNULL.
Expression/Nulls/Coalesce.structure: Two to 127 ordered checked scalar arguments. The owner checks each operand in the expression's scope.
Expression/Nulls/Coalesce.conditions: Use exactly the admitted argument role. Preserve every argument and its evaluation order. Resolve the builtin function and reject invalid arity, star, aggregate ordering, filter and window placement. Scalar ALL and DISTINCT are accepted by SQLite and do not change evaluation.
Expression/Nulls/Coalesce.meaning: Evaluate arguments in order until one is non-NULL. Preserve the selected value and storage class. With no such value return NULL. Later expressions stay unevaluated while their lexical markers remain registered. Preserve the explicit collation carried by the arguments.
Expression/Nulls/Coalesce.externalInterpretation: Use the installed SQLite builtins and the enclosing column slots. Runtime bindings occupy the explicit numbered slots.
Expression/Nulls/Coalesce.sql: Emit COALESCE with every operand in its original argument position. IFNULL has the same binary native operation.

Expression/Nulls/CoalesceArgument.role: A scalar evaluated at one position of the first non-NULL operation.
Expression/Nulls/CoalesceArgument.structure: One checked scalar from the closed SQLite expression graph.
Expression/Nulls/CoalesceArgument.conditions: Only the explicit immutable scalar alternatives are admitted. The owning statement checks scope and budgets.
Expression/Nulls/CoalesceArgument.meaning: Evaluate this scalar only when every previous argument has returned NULL.
Expression/Nulls/CoalesceArgument.externalInterpretation: Use the same native scalar and parameter roles as the owner.
Expression/Nulls/CoalesceArgument.sql: Emit the checked scalar with explicit grouping when required.
